title: Why the Lions and Cowboys Always Play on Thanksgiving 🦃 #NFL #shorts
description:
The Detroit Lions have hosted on Thanksgiving since 1934, when they lost 19–16 to the Chicago Bears. The Dallas Cowboys joined as annual hosts in 1966 with a 26–14 win over the Cleveland Browns, and have hosted every year except 1975 and 1977. A third, prime-time game was added in 2006 and a Black Friday game in 2023. This Thursday it's Bears at Lions again, Eagles at Cowboys and Chiefs at Bills.
